skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-google-ads-customer-match
skill.description: Set up six Google Ads Customer Match lists for a Cloudflare website through Product Metrics. Verify purchase tracking and consent before lists begin filling from eligible orders.
skill.summary: Set up consent-based Google Ads audiences from purchases on a Cloudflare website.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts flag Markdown formatting, legitimate setup checks, or ordinary documentation rather than shell evaluation or host reconnaissance. Confirmed risks include authenticated writes without explicit approval, sensitive order reads, an unpinned installer, and live documentation used as workflow instructions. The workflow can also expand tracking beyond Customer Match, requests blanket Cloudflare permissions, and permits unsafe handling of unrelated credentials.

remediation.issue: Authenticated writes and setup beyond Customer Match
remediation.suggestion: Preview each change, target account, and data destination before asking for approval. Keep conversion tracking and other ad channels out of scope unless separately authorized.

remediation.issue: Order details are read for routine verification
remediation.suggestion: Use the last purchase status or a designated test order. Request separate approval for production order details and avoid displaying customer data.

remediation.issue: Installer and fallback instructions are not pinned
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and skill revision, and require user approval before running the installer. Bundle reviewed reference files instead of following live instructions.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting requests blanket permission approval
remediation.suggestion: List the required permissions, explain the site-wide changes, and confirm the intended zone. Instruct users to stop if the grant differs from the reviewed scope.

remediation.issue: Unrelated credentials can pass through chat or command arguments
remediation.suggestion: Remove credential exceptions from this workflow. Use provider-hosted authorization or a dedicated secret-entry flow for services that require credentials.

content.user_title: Set Up Google Ads Customer Match on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: Purchase-based audiences become outdated without a reliable way to refresh them. Set up six Google Ads Customer Match lists that Product Metrics updates as eligible orders arrive.
actual_capabilities: Checks Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP server.
Guides verification of the Cloudflare gateway, Google Ads connection, and a test purchase.
Shows how to select a supported consent banner and accept Customer Match terms.
Guides creation of six managed lists and checks which lists already exist.
Explains how to find the lists in Google Ads and verify membership after eligible purchases.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, workspace admin access, and a proxied Cloudflare storefront.
Requires Google Ads conversion tracking and a connected Merchant Center account.
Cloudflare Tracking does not import historical orders. An alternative webhook integration requires a developer.
Customer lists are for Google Ads only. The skill does not apply lists to campaigns or change bids.

use_cases.title: Check storefront readiness
use_cases.description: Verify the Cloudflare connection and confirm that Product Metrics receives a test purchase.

use_cases.title: Prepare new customer exclusions
use_cases.description: Set up the All customers list so you can exclude existing buyers in Google Ads.

use_cases.title: Plan a returning customer campaign
use_cases.description: Locate the Lapsed customers list and confirm it has members before using it in a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Review prerequisites
prompt_templates.scenario: You are planning a first setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need for Customer Match on my Cloudflare storefront. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a test purchase
prompt_templates.scenario: You have placed a test order.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my designated test purchase reached Product Metrics. Do not retrieve other orders or show personal information.

prompt_templates.title: Set up missing lists
prompt_templates.scenario: Tracking is live and the Google Ads terms are accepted.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check which Customer Match lists exist for my storefront and Google Ads account. Confirm the account with me before any changes.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose empty lists
prompt_templates.scenario: Lists exist but show no members.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tracking status, consent settings, and whether a qualifying purchase arrived after list creation. Report what is missing without changing any settings.

output_examples.input: Is my storefront ready to create Customer Match lists?
output: Cloudflare tracking is active, and Product Metrics received the test purchase.
Accept the Customer Match terms in Google Ads before creating lists.

output_examples.input: Why do my new Customer Match lists show no members?
output: All six lists exist in the selected Google Ads account.
Customers join after an eligible purchase with both required consent choices enabled.
Check membership after an eligible order arrives. No campaign settings were changed.

best_practices: Confirm the storefront, workspace property, and Google Ads client account before approving changes.
Verify that the selected consent banner matches the one your storefront uses.
Use a designated test order to verify purchase tracking without opening unrelated production records.
anti_patterns: Do not share passwords, API keys, or customer records in chat.
Do not create lists before tracking is live and the required consent and terms are in place.
Do not assume new lists include past orders or automatically change campaign settings.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. Cloudflare Tracking uses the proxied storefront and its order confirmation page.

faq.question: Can the assistant accept Customer Match terms for me?
faq.answer: No. A user with the required access must accept the terms in Google Ads.

faq.question: Which consent banners are supported?
faq.answer: Cloudflare Tracking supports OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, and Osano.

faq.question: When does a buyer join a list?
faq.answer: A buyer can join after a purchase made after list creation. Both ad user data and ad personalization consent must be granted.

faq.question: Does this include orders placed before tracking was enabled?
faq.answer: No. Cloudflare Tracking does not import order history. A developer can use a separate webhook integration to send historical orders.

faq.question: Does creating lists change my campaigns?
faq.answer: No. You choose where to use each list in Google Ads. The setup does not change bidding or targeting.
